lines: Every page of the app now shares one header, with full screen at its end.
Press Full screen and the ride fills the display. The button then reads Exit full screen. Where the browser cannot do it, there is no button.
Race, Classes and Profile each mark their own item, so you always know where you are.
Your streak, your level and your XP sit at the end, and the level goes to Profile.
On a phone the navigation takes its own row, and the level shows just its badge.
From a phone to a laptop, the same header grows to fit.
What the tests prove: full screen in and out, no button without the API, and every page's own item.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
